title: 3-Day Mikumi Safari with Maasai Visit
bestTimeToGo: June to October for dry season; animals gather around water sources making them easier to spot
highlights: Game drives through Mikumi National Park — elephants, giraffes, lions, zebras
Travel by ferry and Tanzania’s express electric train through the countryside
Visit an authentic Maasai village and learn about their ancient culture
All food, drinks, park entrance fees, and transport from Zanzibar included
includes: Ferry ticket Zanzibar to Dar es Salaam
Express electric train Dar es Salaam to Morogoro
All ground transportation and safari vehicle
All meals (lunch Day 1, dinner, breakfast Day 2, lunch Day 2)
Maasai village visit and cultural experience
excludes: Gratuities for guide and lodge staff

itinerary.dayTitle: Day 1 — Zanzibar to Mikumi — Game Drive Adventure
itinerary.dayBody: 05:00 AM — Early hotel pickup in Zanzibar and transfer to the ferry terminal. 07:00 AM — Ferry departure across the Indian Ocean to Dar es Salaam. 08:30 AM — Arrive in Dar and transfer to the electric train station. Board the express electric train for a comfortable 1.5-hour journey to Morogoro, passing through rural Tanzania’s beautiful countryside. Stop for lunch in Morogoro to recharge. 11:15 AM — Drive to Mikumi National Park, arriving in time for an afternoon game drive through this incredible park. Spot elephants, giraffes, lions, zebras, hippos, wildebeest, and much more as the African sun sets over the savannah. Check into your safari lodge for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.dayTitle: Day 2 — Morning Game Drive & Maasai Village
itinerary.dayBody: Rise early for a sunrise game drive when animals are most active. Explore different sections of the park, following your expert guide’s knowledge of the best spots. After a bush breakfast, visit a local Maasai village to learn about their ancient pastoral culture, traditional homes, and way of life. Enjoy lunch before beginning the return journey to Dar es Salaam via Morogoro.
After breakfast, take the express train back to Dar es Salaam and connect with the ferry back to Zanzibar. Transfer to your hotel. Your safari adventure is complete — welcome back to island life!

whatToBring: Warm layer for early morning game drives
pickupInfo: Early morning hotel pickup in Zanzibar included. Exact time confirmed the evening before based on hotel location.
cancellationPolicyShort: Free cancellation up to 7 days before the start date. 50% refund for cancellations 3–6 days before.

seo.title: 3-Day Mikumi Safari from Zanzibar | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: Experience Tanzania’s incredible wildlife on a 3-day safari to Mikumi National Park from Zanzibar. Includes game drives, Maasai village visit, all meals and transport.

content:
Combine the tropical paradise of Zanzibar with the wild heart of Tanzania on this action-packed 3-day safari. Starting from your Zanzibar hotel, you’ll travel by ferry and express train through the Tanzanian mainland to reach Mikumi National Park — one of Tanzania’s most accessible and wildlife-rich parks.

Mikumi sits in the shadow of the Uluguru Mountains and shares an unfenced border with the Selous Game Reserve, making it a corridor for some of Africa’s greatest wildlife. Expect to see elephants, giraffes, lions, zebras, hippos, wildebeest, and buffalo, all from the comfort of your safari vehicle with an expert guide at the wheel.

The journey itself is part of the adventure — the express electric train ride through rural Tanzania gives you a window into mainland life that most Zanzibar visitors never experience. Add a visit to an authentic Maasai village and you have a safari experience that combines wildlife, culture, and adventure. Everything is included: food, drinks, park fees, accommodation, and all transport from Zanzibar and back.
